project_info.name: NusaFreight ERP - Freight Forwarding & Logistics Management System
project_info.target_audience: Internal Freight Forwarding Teams (Sales, CS, Customs, Finance, Pricing, Admin)
project_info.description: Enterprise-grade logistics management system featuring granular RBAC, real-time quotation calculators, heavy data tables with column-level security, Customs import tax calculators, multi-currency financial accounting, XML Coretax export, and live shipment tracking.

theme_strategy.rationale: High-density enterprise data operations require crisp contrast, low eye fatigue during long shifts, and a sleek tactical aesthetic combining dark slate with vibrant cobalt highlights.

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-50
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
hierarchy.small_label: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-400

colors.archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / SWISS HIGH-CONTRAST LOGISTICS

spacing_and_layout.grid_mode: MODE B: High Density Enterprise Grid
spacing_and_layout.table_density: compact padded rows with subtle hover highlights
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Strict left-aligned text, right-aligned monetary & numerical figures

sidebar_navigation.style: Fixed collapsible sidebar with division badge and active role switcher
features: Role-scoped menu visibility (Sales, CS, Customs, Finance, Pricing, Admin)
Role switcher for demonstration/testing with immediate UI scope shift

data_tables.style: High-density TanStack Table styling with sticky header, column visibility manager, sorting, filtering, and RBAC column locks
features: Granular column access (e.g., CS sees operational columns; Finance unlocks Revenue, Buy/Sell Rates, and Net Margin columns)
Export options (CSV, Excel, XML Coretax format)
Inline status steppers and quick action menus
Document standard uploader (BL, CIPL, COO) with auto-rename rule (`[JOB_NO]_[DOC_TYPE]_[DATE]`)
Shipment progress timeline stepper (Quotation -> Booking -> Pick Up -> Port Loading -> On Vessel -> Customs Clearance -> Delivered -> Invoiced)
Schedule Arrive H-2 notification system with dismissible toast alert and email summary mock
Invoice, CN, DN, Payment Requisition, Kasbon & Reimbursement forms
Chart of Accounts (COA) tree and Balance Sheet view
Statement of Account (SOA) generator for Customers & Partners
Export Coretax XML format generator conforming to Indonesian Directorate General of Taxes guidelines

testing_strategy.rule: ALL interactive components, buttons, form inputs, modal dialogs, status badges, table rows, and tab triggers MUST contain a clear kebab-case data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a modern, high-density enterprise ERP interface for Indonesian freight forwarding operations.
Ensure 6 functional roles with quick role-switching header bar: Sales, Customer Service, Customs, Finance, Pricing, Admin.
Implement column-level RBAC on Job Order table: Finance sees buy/sell profit margins, while CS sees operational milestones.
Include real-time Import Tax Calculator (PPN, PPh, Bea Masuk) and LCL Calculator (CBM vs Ton volume weight logic).
Include XML Coretax export for Finance module and auto-rename document upload for BL, CIPL, COO.
Use Sonner for active toast alerts (e.g. H-2 Schedule Arrive warnings, quotation updates, tax calculations).
Strictly follow design tokens: slate dark background #0B0F17, blue primary #2563EB, crisp 1px borders, font hierarchy with Plus Jakarta Sans & IBM Plex Sans.
Attach data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
